answer: Each identity files one quartz artifact, etched with a key-bound serial, into the public lotus registry and locks a 70-credit bond. At dawn auditors replay the registry and spot-check filings: a reused serial, a rented artifact whose key mismatches, or a missing artifact burns the 70 bond. Forging one filing costs 45, so 1,000 fakes pay 45,000 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once for 45 and keeps its share.
